metadata.title: docs-notes-retrieval - Sources
metadata.description: Official and community references for local-first note-vault retrieval, markdown packaging, and notebook-style exports.

official_sources.name: Obsidian Help
official_sources.description: Official Obsidian documentation for vault structure, frontmatter, wikilinks, and graph-native note workflows.

official_sources.name: CommonMark Specification
official_sources.description: Markdown baseline for normalizing note content across local note systems.

community_patterns.name: Obsidian Skills
community_patterns.description: Official Obsidian-maintainer Agent Skills package (kepano) implementing the Agent Skills spec for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode: obsidian-markdown (wikilinks/embeds/callouts/properties), obsidian-bases, json-canvas, obsidian-cli, and defuddle (clean-markdown web extraction). Verified 2026-07-11.

community_patterns.name: NotebookLM Integration
community_patterns.description: Community pattern for preparing NotebookLM-adjacent note workflows, summaries, and source bundles.

community_patterns.name: Claude Deep Research Skill
community_patterns.description: Reference for staged research packaging when notes and source bundles feed a broader synthesis workflow.

community_patterns.name: Karpathy LLM Wiki gist
community_patterns.description: General-purpose bootstrap prompt for an LLM that incrementally builds an interlinked markdown wiki from raw sources. Three-part split: raw sources, generated wiki (entities/concepts/sources/synthesis), schema docs. Tool-agnostic; works with Claude Code, Codex, or Obsidian-style local vaults.

community_patterns.name: AI Edge — How to Give Claude Perfect Memory
community_patterns.description: Practitioner three-layer memory guide (thread active 2026-04-22, existence and substance confirmed via search 2026-07-11; specific view/bookmark counts could not be independently verified and are not cited). Used narrowly for the archive-snapshot recipe in the 'Snapshot the AI-owned layer' subsection: weekly point-in-time copy of the AI-owned memory directory to a read-only location outside the agent's write scope. The article's 4-file Master Folder variant (Instructions/Memory/Context/Archive-Guide) is intentionally NOT adopted to avoid proliferating journaling-file schemes alongside Hayduk, Watts, Karpathy, and Ganim.

community_patterns.name: Corey Ganim — AI-Curated Wiki Pattern
community_patterns.description: Practitioner pattern (thread active 2026-04-06, existence and substance confirmed via search 2026-07-11; specific view/bookmark counts could not be independently verified and are not cited) for an AI-curated knowledge base: raw/ (human append-only) + wiki/ (AI-rewritten, AI-owned) + outputs/ (generated artifacts) + CLAUDE.md as schema file. Source for the 'AI-Curated Wiki Variant (Ganim Pattern)' section: the 4-step compounding loop, the verbatim monthly health-check prompt, and the 'plain folders > plugin stacks' tooling stance.
